properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 20 at 6:16PM CDT until September 21 at 12:15AM CDT by NWS Springfield MO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Greene County in southwestern Missouri...

* WHEN...Until 1215 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Overflowing poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 616 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Springfield, Battlefield, Strafford, Galloway and Turners.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 1215 AM CDT MONDAY

_provenance.trust_anchor: TLS to api.weather.gov + our own signature over the fetched bytes. NWS CAP products retrieved via this API are not individually signed in a way this system can verify end to end; this is not a verified NWS signature.
